key_factors: Ball studs and link housing
decisive_step: Machining, heat treating, welding, plating/coating of the forged stud blank and steel bar into finished ball studs and link housing, and final assembly in Thailand
flip: Importing the ball studs and link housing from China in a fully machined and heat-treated state, leaving only coating and simple assembly in Thailand
reasoning: Consistent with CBP precedents N346637 and N347758, the rough forged ball stud blanks and raw steel bars from China do not yet possess the essential character of the finished components. In Thailand, they undergo extensive machining (rough and finish turning), heat treatment, welding of the eyelets and rod, surface plating/E-coating, and final assembly. These complex manufacturing operations substantially transform the Chinese blanks and raw materials into a new and different article of commerce originating in Thailand.

key_factors: Aluminum inner and outer pole sections
decisive_step: Machining of Vietnamese-origin aluminum pipe profiles and final assembly in Vietnam

In Vietnam, Vietnamese-origin aluminum pipe profiles are cut, grooved, chamfered, and dotted, and then assembled with the Chinese-origin injection-molded plastic fittings. Because the dominant component originates and is fully processed in Vietnam alongside final assembly, the country of origin is Vietnam.

key_factors: Oil filter element assembly and metal housing manufactured and assembled in Thailand
decisive_step: Manufacturing the pleated filter element (origami), center tube, and metal shell, and performing the 34-step complex assembly in Thailand

key_factors: Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA)
decisive_step: SMT and through-hole assembly of the PCBA in Indonesia
flip: Performing the SMT and through-hole assembly of the PCBA in China
reasoning: Consistent with CBP precedent (e.g., N334757, N346631), the PCBA imparts the essential character to the battery charger by providing its core charging and control functionality. key_factors: Ratchet handles, bit drivers, and adapters
decisive_step: Manufacturing of the primary driving tools (ratchet handles, bit drivers, adapters, and extensions) in Vietnam
flip: Manufacturing the ratchet handles and bit drivers in China instead of Vietnam
reasoning: Packaging various hand tools into retail sets does not result in a substantial transformation. key_factors: Rubber mallet, tapping block, and spacers (or the kit components of Chinese origin)
decisive_step: Manufacturing of the majority of the kit components (mallet, tapping block, spacers) in China
flip: Manufacturing the rubber mallet, tapping block, and spacers in Vietnam along with the pull bar

key_factors: The individual tools (sockets, bits, screwdrivers, ratchet handle, and adapter), which each retain their own separate country of origin; China represents the origin of the vast majority of items.
decisive_step: Manufacturing of the individual tool components in China and Vietnam; mere packaging into retail sets does not substantially transform the tools.

However, as the overwhelming majority of components by count and functional variety (sockets, bits, and 19 screwdrivers) are entirely made in China, with only the ratchet handle and adapter from Vietnam, China is the primary country of origin driving the sets.

key_factors: Multi-stage fabrication of key structural/electronic subassemblies (PCBA via SMT, outer wrapper, bottom plate, door assembly) and complex 36-step final assembly
decisive_step: SMT production of the PCBA, metal stamping and powder coating of the wrapper and bottom plate, door subassembly, and 36-step final assembly in Mexico

key_factors: PCBA and SMD LED sub-assembly (LED light source)
